title: Stan Whiteman - Lesson #1 - WOMEN'S FANCY SHAWL DANCE - Blackfoot Language Lessons

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher provides cultural context and explains the significance of the dance. He speaks in both Blackfoot and English to preserve the language while teaching the steps.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces himself and his community in Blackfoot and English.
The teacher explains the cultural significance of the dance as a butterfly dance.
A female dancer performs the dance while the teacher speaks in Blackfoot.
The teacher summarizes the significance of the dance and repeats the Blackfoot terminology.

what_works: The teacher provides clear cultural context for the dance.
what_hinders: The video does not break down the steps for the viewer to follow.

quotes.text: that this dance was like a butterfly dance for the women
They're going to be dancing the women's fancy shawl
It represents the butterfly, what they call the women's fancy shawl dance

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher speaks directly to the camera in a formal setting.
A female dancer performs the dance in a large indoor space.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teacher uses the video as a platform for language preservation, interweaving Blackfoot terminology with English explanations of the dance's cultural meaning.
